Sync.Description: The centre's two laptops: each works alone, and they exchange their changes, sealed, whenever there is internet.
Sync.ManagerOnly: Only the manager sets up sync, adds or removes a laptop and settles conflicts.
Sync.NotSetUp: Sync is not set up on this laptop. The manager sets it up here.

Bar.Waiting: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waiting to be sent} one {# change waiting to be sent} other {# changes waiting to be sent}}

ProblemTitles.LEGAL_INCIDENT: Invoices or receipts from a removed laptop
ProblemTitles.REVOKED: This laptop was removed from sync
ProblemTitles.REJOIN: This laptop must join the centre again
ProblemTitles.CATCH_UP_OFFLINE: Waiting for the internet to catch up
ProblemTitles.CLOCK: This laptop's clock is not set right
ProblemTitles.HELD: Changes from the other laptop are held
ProblemTitles.CONFLICTS: The same field was changed on both laptops
ProblemTitles.LIMIT: The service has reached its daily limit
ProblemTitles.FILES_MISSING: Some stored files have not arrived yet

ProblemHints.LEGAL_INCIDENT: {count, plural, one {# document was} other {# documents were}} issued on a laptop after its books were taken. They are kept whole below, outside the chain: the director decides what to do with them on paper.
ProblemHints.REVOKED: It was removed on the other laptop. It keeps its data but exchanges nothing more. To work with the centre again, it must join with a new code.
ProblemHints.FULL: The mailbox refuses new envelopes. Nothing is lost: each laptop keeps its changes. Call the developer to free room.
ProblemHints.REJOIN: This database is older than what the mailbox still holds, or from before sync. Ask for a new code on the other laptop and join again.
ProblemHints.CATCH_UP_OFFLINE: A copy was restored on this laptop: it must take back what the other laptop did before anyone works. Connect it to the internet.
ProblemHints.CLOCK: It differs from the mailbox's time by {difference}. Correct the date and time of Windows.
ProblemHints.HELD: {count, plural, one {# change was} other {# changes were}} refused by this database. Open the list below and choose what to do.
ProblemHints.CONFLICTS: {count, plural, one {# field was} other {# fields were}} changed on both laptops while apart. The later value was kept; the other one is below, one click to use it.
ProblemHints.LIMIT: The free service resumes at {time}. Both laptops keep working; what waits is sent then.
ProblemHints.OFFLINE: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing waits.} one {# change waits and is sent when the internet returns.} other {# changes wait and are sent when the internet returns.}}
ProblemHints.FILES_MISSING: {count, plural, one {# file is} other {# files are}} still to arrive. They are fetched again at the next exchanges.

SetUp.Title: Set up sync
SetUp.Description: Done once, on the director's laptop, with the mailbox address and the setup key the developer gave. This laptop then holds the books.
SetUp.OriginHint: As the developer wrote it, starting with https.
SetUp.Done: Sync is set up. Add the second laptop now.
SetUp.Failed: Sync could not be set up.

Status.Title: The exchange
Status.Description: Where the exchange with the mailbox stands now.

Devices.Title: The two laptops
Devices.Description: Each laptop keeps the whole program and the whole database.
Devices.HoldsBooks: The books are on this laptop
Devices.Requested: The books were asked for on {date} at {time}. They move at the other laptop's next exchange.
Devices.RequestBooksHint: Invoices, receipts and payments are written only on the laptop that holds the books. They move within a minute while the other laptop is on and online.
Devices.RequestBooksFailed: The books could not be asked for.
Devices.OnlyOne: Only this laptop is in sync yet.

Pair.Title: Add the second laptop
Pair.Description: The assistant signs in on her laptop with her own account. Choose it, or create it now.
Pair.New: A new account for the assistant
Pair.NoOtherAccount: The centre has no account but the manager's: create the assistant's.
Pair.DisplayNameHint: Surname first, as on his forms.
Pair.PasswordHint: She replaces it at her first sign-in. At least {min} characters.
Pair.CodeHint: On the second laptop: install the program, choose «Join an existing centre», then type the mailbox address and this code.
Pair.Expired: This code has expired. Close and ask for a new one.
Pair.Failed: The pairing code could not be made.

Remove.Title: Remove a laptop
Remove.Description: For a laptop that is lost, broken or replaced. Its access to the mailbox is revoked at once and the centre's key is replaced. To bring it back, it must join again with a new code.
Remove.HeldBooks: This laptop holds the books. Type the last invoice and receipt numbers you can see on paper: the numbers up to them are set aside, so that none is issued twice.
Remove.Failed: The laptop could not be removed.

Conflicts.Title: Sync conflicts
Conflicts.Description: What the two laptops did to the same record while apart. Nothing is lost: every other value is kept here.
Conflicts.Deleted: Deleted on one laptop, changed on the other
Conflicts.Incident: Issued after its books were taken
Conflicts.Used: The other value is used, on both laptops.
Conflicts.Failed: The conflict could not be settled.

Held.Title: Held changes
Held.Description: Changes from the other laptop that this database refused. They are tried again at every exchange; a later change may unblock them.

Reasons.UNIQUE: The same thing was registered on both laptops (the same national number, a second accepted quote, the same slot).
Reasons.MISSING_PARENT: The record it belongs to is missing on this laptop.
Reasons.IN_USE: Another record still points at the one deleted on the other laptop.
Reasons.RULE: A rule of the program refused it here (a closed pay run, a decided sanction…).
Reasons.WAITS: It waits for another held change.

Held.SetAsideDescription: The newer record is set aside (it stays in the log), and the held change is applied.
Held.Done: Done. The other laptop follows at its next exchange.

SyncJoin.OfferHint: A new laptop for a centre that already works on another one.
SyncJoin.Title: Join an existing centre
SyncJoin.Description: On the director's laptop: Settings › Sync › «Add the second laptop». Type here the address and the code it shows.
SyncJoin.Restart: The program restarts on the centre's accounts.
SyncJoin.Failed: Joining failed. Check the address and the code, and the internet.

CatchUp.Title: Taking back what the other laptop did
CatchUp.Hint: A copy was restored on this laptop. It takes back from the mailbox what it sent after that copy and everything from the other laptop, then opens.
CatchUp.Offline: There is no internet. This laptop waits, and goes on as soon as it is connected.
CatchUp.Wait: Nobody can work on this laptop until it has caught up.
CatchUp.ManagerChoice: The manager may instead take this laptop out of sync.
CatchUp.Leave: Take this laptop out of sync
CatchUp.LeaveDescription: This laptop then works alone, as before sync, and the other one goes on without it. To bring it back, it must join again with a new code.
CatchUp.LeaveFailed: This laptop could not be taken out of sync.

Rejoin.Title: This laptop must join the centre again
Rejoin.Hint: This laptop is from before sync was set up, or older than what the mailbox still holds. It joins again from the centre's full copy, with its own keys, then restarts.
Rejoin.Submit: Join again from the centre's copy

Access.SignedOut: Your account was switched off on the other laptop. You have been signed out.
Access.Changed: Your access was changed on the other laptop.

SyncAttention.Title: Sync needs attention
SyncAttention.Hint: Conflicts, held changes, or a problem with the exchange between the two laptops

Errors.BooksOnOtherLaptop: The books are on the other laptop. Ask for them, and try again when they have arrived.
Errors.BooksOnTheirWay: The books are on their way to this laptop: the last invoices and receipts have not all arrived yet. Try again in a minute.
Errors.BooksAlreadyHere: The books are already on this laptop.
Errors.BooksNotOnThatLaptop: The books are not on that laptop.
Errors.ClaimOutsideBlocks: This number is not among those given before the two laptops were joined, nor among this laptop's own numbers: it cannot be typed here.
Errors.PaperNumberLastSeen: Type the last number seen on paper, from 0 to 999999.
Errors.SyncAlreadySetUp: Sync is already set up on this laptop.
Errors.SyncNotSetUp: Sync is not set up on this laptop.
Errors.SyncSetupKey: The mailbox refused this setup key.
Errors.SyncNotMailbox: No mailbox answers at this address. Check the address the developer gave.
Errors.SyncOffline: The mailbox cannot be reached. Check the internet connection and try again.
Errors.SyncLimit: The mailbox has reached its daily limit. Try again after 01:00.
Errors.SyncFull: The mailbox is full. Ask the developer to free some room.
Errors.SyncTwoLaptops: The centre already has its two laptops. Remove one first.
Errors.SyncCodeUnknown: This code is not valid, or was already used, or has expired. Ask for a new code.
Errors.SyncCodeTypo: This code is mistyped. Check each group of four characters.
Errors.SyncHasWork: This laptop already holds work. A laptop joins a centre only when it is freshly installed.
Errors.SyncNoCopy: The mailbox holds no full copy of the centre yet. Try again in a few minutes.
Errors.SyncManagerRole: The assistant's account cannot have the manager's role.
Errors.SyncDeviceUnknown: This laptop is not part of the centre.
Errors.SyncDeviceThis: This laptop cannot remove itself. Remove it from the other laptop.
Errors.SyncRevoked: This laptop was removed from the centre.
Errors.SyncConflictUnknown: This conflict does not exist or was already settled.
Errors.SyncHeldUnknown: This held change does not exist or was already settled.
Errors.SyncRecordGone: This record was deleted on one of the laptops: its value cannot be put back.
Errors.SyncActionNotAllowed: This record cannot be settled that way.
Errors.SyncStillRefused: The database still refuses this change. Fix the cause first.
Errors.SyncCatchingUpNoNumbers: This laptop is taking back from the mailbox what it did after the backup. Try again when it has caught up.
Errors.SyncLeftWithoutBooks: This laptop was taken out of sync while the other laptop held the books: invoices, receipts and payments are issued there only.
